articleTitle: Additive Manufacturing of Freeform Optics for Defense Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: An additive manufacturing platform, including nanocomposite materials and 3D printing, is presented that allows 3D-freeform gradient index (GRIN) functions to be fabricated within planar or surfaced lens elements. The degrees of design freedom allow for realization of complex optical functions that reduce optical system size and weight.

articleTitle: Receive-beamforming-enhanced Linear Sampling Method imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a study on the effects of introducing a receive beamforming operation into the Linear Sampling Method (LSM) for electromagnetic imaging of targets. The rationale of applying the beamforming operation is to reduce the dimensionality of the LSM system of equations and thus enable operation using a sparse or limited aspect set of sensors. We present the mathematical formulation of the beamforming-enhanced LSM with two different regularization schemes and provide an imaging demonstration with simulated data.

articleTitle: Further Enhancements to the PDP Architecture and State-of-the-art Results for High-speed IRSP Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: PDP has been used to drive high-speed IRSP systems and has continued to evolve over the past year. Architectural enhancements have been made to increase performance for dynamic refresh-rates and sub-windowing capabilities. This paper presents the latest architecture enhancements, high-speed results, and new features added.

Author Keywords: Infrared light emitting diodes scene projectors

articleTitle: Integrated Microwave Photonic Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We review the latest advances in on-chip microwave photonics and describe recent demonstrations using Lincoln Laboratory’s photonic multi-chip module (P-MCM) hybrid integration platform including high-power lasers, wideband modulators, reconfigurable optical filters and wideband high-saturation photodiodes, suitable for the realization of high-performance microwave photonic subsystems-on-a-chip.

articleTitle: Rapid 3D fabrication of micro-optical components for tailored imaging and sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The development of two-photon lithographic technologies is enabling the fabrication of 3D structures at sub-micron resolution with optical materials. The freedom allotted by these technologies allows for the fabrication of miniaturized optical systems and complex micro-optical components. Additionally, the ability to rapid prototype micro-optical components with these technologies makes it suitable for providing an option for custom tailored imaging applications that include quantitative imaging modalities. Utilizing such technologies, an advanced approach is taken for the development of a fiberscope for specific imaging applications. Submillimeter freeform shape lenses, aperture, and micro-optical housing are fabricated as distal-end components to replace conventional micro-optical components of an endoscopic platform to enable long- working distance, high-resolution, imaging applications. Beam shapers are also fabricated at the distal ends of optical fibers to reduce the numerical aperture of each illumination fiber, aligning the area of illumination to the area observed by the imager. Optimization of beam shapers serves to provide relatively uniform and non-saturated illumination of the target area. Together, this custom optical system can outperform commercially available equivalents and is an example of how this 3D fabrication technology can offer improved alternatives to conventional micro-optics of today. Moving forward, development and incorporation of more complex micro-optical components, such as diffractive optical elements together with additional 3D printed sensors, can serve to bring quantitative power to further expanding the applicability of new miniaturized imaging and sensing systems. Examples to illustrate capabilities are presented.

articleTitle: Rapid Multi-Sensor Fusion and Integration Using AI-enabled Machine Vision for Real-Time Operator Physiological Status
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Real-time in-situ tracking of operator physiological status requires the integration and analysis of inputs from multiple sensors. Data formats and sample rates differ making the integration of data streams challenging. The use of external AIML Machine Vision can increase data analysis multivariate sensor fusion in such applications

articleTitle: Full-Resolution Two-Color Infrared Detector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We discuss thinned InAsSb resonant infrared detectors that are designed to enable high quantum efficiency by using interleaved nanoantennas to read out two wavelengths from each pixel simultaneously.

articleTitle: Transitioning the worlds first 1Kx1K Infrared LED Scene Projector Systems from Research and Development (R&D) to Production Level
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: With recent improvements to the 1Kx1K Infrared LED Scene Projector (IRSP) system, Chip Design Systems (CDS) and the University of Delaware (UDel) are in the process of transitioning this technology from research and development (R&D) to production level. (Abstract))

articleTitle: Biomedical and Biotechnology Applications of Deep Ultraviolet Light Emitting Diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic rekindled attention to biomedical application of the Deep Ultraviolet Light Emitting Diodes that include killing bacteria and viruses, purifying air, disinfecting water supplies, prolonging food storage, increasing plant yield, improving produce quality post-harvest, adjusting lighting spectral power distribution, and regulating circadian rhythm.

articleTitle: Low-cost and Rapid micro-RNA Assay for Identification of Pancreactic Cancer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Electromagnetic based micro-RNA sensor was developed and applied to analyze pancreatic cancer biomarkers in plasma samples. Results confirmed the previous finding of differential expression levels of micro-RNA between healthy and pancreatic cancer patients.

articleTitle: MEMS Back-Scanning Mirrors for Step-Stare Scanning for Chirped Pulse Coherent LIDAR
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We are investigating the design and demonstration of a back scanning correction mirror for use in coherent LiDAR. Our aim is a mirror with a resonant frequency of over 100 kHz and a 10% settling time of under $10\ \mu \mathrm{s}$.

articleTitle: Applying Gaussian Mixture Models to Detect Fish from Airborne LiDAR Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Airborne LiDAR has been used to monitor marine life and ecological health. However, manually searching the data for important features is an inefficient process. Here, we use Gaussian Mixture Models and supervised classification techniques to automatically detect fish in airborne LiDAR data.

articleTitle: Physically-Secure Low-Power Human State Measurement using EQS-HBC and Edge-Analytics : Invited Paper
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper discusses recent advancements in smart connected biophysical signal sensing technology focusing on the development of wearable biosensors and the use of Electro-Quasistatic Human Body Communication and Edge-Analytics in the human state measurement systems for lower power consumption and physical layer security.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Insects in Lidar Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Lidar instruments have recently been developed for detecting insects during flight. However, insect detection algorithms are needed for automating the tedious, manual detection process. We report the use of a Subspace Discriminant classifier to detect insects in lidar data collected in the field.

articleTitle: Hardware Modifications for Controlling Duty Cycle to Reduce LED Power in Existing Infrared LED Scene Projectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In our existing infrared LED scene projector system, the LEDs receive power 100% of the time when the system is drawing, resulting in unwanted heating and radiance droop. This paper characterizes the hardware modifications implemented to reduce the duty cycle of the LED power supplies.

articleTitle: Next Generation Data Link for IRSP Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The video links used in current IRSP systems add unnecessary overhead and complexity that is hindering the widespread adoption of PDP. This paper will provide an overview of an alternative serial data transfer method over fiber optic cables.

Author Keywords: infrared light emitting diodes scene projectors

articleTitle: Micromechanically enabled microcavity on optical fiber tips
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report micromechanically enabled 3D optical microcavities fabricated directly onto cleaved ends of low-loss optical fibers by a two-photon polymerization (2PP) process. This fabrication technique is quick, simple, and inexpensive compared to planar microfabrication processes, which enables rapid prototyping and the ability to adapt to new design specifications. These devices also utilize true 3D design freedom, facilitating the realization of microscale optomechanical elements with challenging geometries. A released hemispherical Fabry–Pérot (FP) cavity was sculpted on a fiber tip using 2PP process and demonstrated an extinction ratio of around 253. In addition, a mechanically enabled FP cavity featuring a multi-positional hinged mirror was fabricated by 2PP on a fiber tip. The hinged mirror enables both a concave optical surface and high-reflective (HR) coating to be integrated into a cavity less than $30\ \mu \mathrm{m}$ long. The addition of micromechanical components and HR coating has improved the FP cavity’s resonant quality by better than 10x compared to the FP cavity without HR coating.

articleTitle: Design of Infrared Thermoelectric Coupled Nanoantennas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The paper presents a design-oriented analysis of a dipole nanoantenna suspended above a cavity. A thermocouple junction resolves the temperature of the antenna. The low thermal inertia of the device and low noise provide a high potential for high detectivity. Experimental results are compared to the model.

articleTitle: Hybrid Chalcogenide/Polymer Coherent Fiber Bundles for MWIR Image Relays
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Coherent fiber bundles (CFBs) provide a convenient mechanism to relay high-resolution images for various applications. We draw small pitch MWIR CFBs from high-contrast step-index fibers of chalcogenide (ChG) cores and polymer claddings. We show that small core size differences minimize crosstalk in these CFBs.

articleTitle: Constructal Theory Modeling of Colloidal Particle Assembly
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The assembly of colloidal particles into ordered structures is of great importance to a variety of nano-scale applications. Here, we use constructal theory to develop a theoretical model to describe the assembly mechanism with respect to van der Waals and double layer interactions.

articleTitle: Dissipative Quantum Transport Study of A Bi-Layer Graphene-CdTe-HgCdTe Heterostructure for MWIR Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recent experimental investigations in Bi-Layer Graphene (BLG) have shown interesting and useful electrical behavior that can be leveraged in building novel device applications. One such behavior being carrier multiplication effects within the BLG. We propose to use a heterostructure of BLG-CdTe-HgCdTe as a detector structure that marries this effect along with the unique bandalignment of the heterostructure which suggest an Ohmic contact for the electrons but a Schottky barrier for the holes. Using a dissipative quantum transport model, namely the Non-Equilibrium Green’s Functions with self-consistent Born approximation accounting for electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions, we calculate energy and position resolved electron and hole currents through these heterostructure and discover a 20X ratio of electron-to-hole ratio in an illustrative simulation which demonstrates the potential for reducing the hole contribution to dark current and modulating the recombination mechanisms and therefore the lifetime of the carriers in the heterostructure.

articleTitle: Silicon Quantum Photonic Integrated Circuits Comprising Superconducting Nanostripe Single-Photon Detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report on design, fabrication, and characterization of silicon quantum photonic integrated circuits comprising superconducting nanostripe single-photon detectors integrated with dielectric optical waveguides. In order to enhance absorption of photons by the superconducting nanostripes, the detectors are located directly on the dielectric waveguide core.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Complementary Power Measurement for Microwave Instantaneous Frequency Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A high-precision photonic based instantaneous frequency measurement system driven by machine learning is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. A three-layer deep neural network is used to tackle device nonlinearity and system noise, resulting in absolute error <50 MHz and 1.1 MHz root mean square error.

articleTitle: Direct sampling algorithms based on the factorization method for inverse scattering
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We will discuss three direct sampling algorithms that can be used for recovering scatterers from far-field measurements. Two of the indicators are motivated by the factorization method where one is based on Tikhonov regularization. The resolution analysis is studied and implemented numerically.

articleTitle: Linear refractive index measurement from visible to infrared region using common path interferometry
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We develop a common path interferometer to measure the refractive index in liquids. This technique can measure the refractive index from the visible to infrared. In this work, we present experimental data in four wavelengths for several organic solvents.

articleTitle: Microresonator-switch-based silicon-photonic true-time-delay beamforming circuit for RF phased-array antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A chip-scale silicon PIC-based tunable delay line using a 10-by-15 microring resonator array with integrated photodetectors and thermo-optic switching elements was implemented and experimentally characterized.

articleTitle: High efficiency end-fire 3-D optical phased array based on multi-layers SiN/SiO platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: OPA device has been widely studied for solid-state Lidar. We have investigated a multi-layers SiN/SiO structure to end-fire the beam with high efficiency. The advantage of the structure, simulation result and fabrication feasibility are discussed. In addition, the latest fabrication progress is also presented.

articleTitle: Progress in LWIR Dielectric Metasurface Tunable Notch Filters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report $8-12\ \mu \mathrm{m}$ longwave infrared tunable notch filters using the guided-mode resonance (GMR) effect in dielectric metasurfaces. This region corresponds to an atmospheric window that is widely used for sensing and imaging applications for day/night situational awareness.

articleTitle: Light Effect Transistors for High-Speed and Low-Energy Electronic and Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Chip level electronic-photonic integration faces multiple challenges: wavelength mismatch, energy-data rate, and cascadability and fan-out. A light effect transistor (LET) can offer opto-electronic hybridization at the component level, allowing Moore’s law to continue to the quantum regime without requiring complex FET structure.

articleTitle: Manipulating quantum states of photons on integrated photonic chips
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In this talk, we will discuss our recent progress in engineering micro/nanophotonic device structures for producing and manipulating photonic quantum states on chip.

articleTitle: A Tunable and Highly-Efficient Plasmonic Band-Stop Filter at Telecom Wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper reports design and numerical results of an ultra-compact, efficient and tunable plasmonic band-stop filter based on a metal-insulator-metal waveguide at optical channels. Furthermore, a wide-bandgap can be easily achieved by adjusting the width of the of the stub resonator.

articleTitle: Erbium-doped Indium Tin Oxide for Resonance Tuning and Photoluminescence Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We investigate erbium-doped indium tin oxide and report increases to the resistivity and epsilon-near-zero wavelength with increased erbium concentration. These films are being investigated for plasmonics, second harmonic generation, perfect absorption and photoluminescence.

articleTitle: Nuclear Disturbed Environmental Effects on Space-based Single Photon Detectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We consider space-based radiation damage and its cumulative effect on detector dark counts for satellite-based silicon single-photon detectors, arising from natural radiation as well as from a nuclear disturbed environment caused by a high-altitude nuclear explosion.

articleTitle: Beam Pattern Reconfiguration of a Planar Yagi-Uda Antenna Using PIN Diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A pattern reconfigurable Yagi-Uda antenna operating at 2.45 GHz is proposed. Two modes are presented and are synthesized using slits and diodes. The antenna operates as a bi-directional receiver when switches are ‘off’ and as a directional transmitter when switches are ‘on’ or vice versa.

articleTitle: Luminescence thermometry for detection of optical cooling from colloidal quantum dots embedded in dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We have developed a novel method of pump-probe luminescence thermometry based on the detection of photoluminescence signal phase change versus power of the pumping laser, and applied it to studies of optical cooling from colloidal quantum dots embedded in dielectric waveguides.

articleTitle: Non-degenerate two-photon absorption spectroscopy of bulk silicon
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Non-degenerate two-photon absorption (ND-2PA) across the indirect gap of silicon is theoretically and experimentally investigated. Three theoretical pathways for the two photons and a phonon are explained, and the most dominant process is determined by comparing to our measurements and the enhancement of ND-2PA was observed.

articleTitle: Mie Resonance Based Quantum Optical Circuits Integrated with on-chip Single Photon Source Array for Quantum Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present theoretical study on a new class of quantum optical circuits based on Mie resonance of dielectric metastructures, providing all needed light manipulating functions with a single mode eliminating mode-matching problem and thereby enabling entanglement between distinct single photon sources for quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Mid-Wave and Long-Wave Infrared Signature Model and Measurements of Power Lines Against Atmospheric Path Radiance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Matching measured and modelled signal to noise ratio and corresponding visibility of power lines in the mid-wave and long-wave infrared. The signal to noise ratio of the wire depends on emissivity, reflectivity and the background atmosphere and ground path radiance.

articleTitle: Mid Infrared Surface Relief Photonic Devices using High-Index Contrast Amorphous Germanium Sub-wavelength Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Strongly index-modulated sub-wavelength grating structures of amorphous-germanium on low index substrates can realize simple, single-layer spectral filters and nonlinear frequency conversion surfaces in the mid-infrared range. This paper reviews some of our work on the electromagnetic design and experiments on amorphous-germanium based surface-relief photonic devices.

articleTitle: Characterization and Analysis of Large-Area h-BN on Sapphire
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Extensive post-growth microscopic and spectroscopic characterizations are performed to leverage true potentials of high-quality hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). Compressive residual strain between h-BN and sapphire is estimated and corroborated by atomic force microscopy (AFM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Raman spectroscopy also supported the result.

articleTitle: Chaos synchronization in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers for private free-space communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report on the first experimental chaos synchronization in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers and subsequently perform private free-space transmission at a bit-rate of 0.5 Mbits/s. The quality of the privacy is assessed with eye diagrams, both at the legitimate receiver side and illegitimate receiver side.

articleTitle: Hybrid Photonic Lattice with Mode Coupling and Rabi Splitting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We investigate the scattering properties of a paired periodic array of silver-dielectric metasurfaces. We report Fano resonances and Rabi splitting in the spectral response of the scattering parameters. We show that tuning the refractive index of the dielectric scatterer defines whether identical or mismatched resonances are excited in the array.

articleTitle: Multiple Computer Support Electronics (CSE) Test Bed for Infrared Scene Projector Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Multi-CSE is a configurable hardware solution used to drive high-speed Infrared Scene Projector (IRSP) systems. This architecture is used in exploratory testing on higher resolution arrays and faster frame rates, driving both current and future IRSP systems. This paper highlights the developments over the past year.

articleTitle: Coherent Fiber-Optic Link with High SFDR Using DSP Linearization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a novel coherent amplitude modulated RF Photonic link with optical down-conversion that can achieve high-dynamic range using balanced detection and digital linearization. The architecture is presented along with simulated results that show enhancements in third-order intermodulation of $\sim$ 33dB after linearization.

articleTitle: Estimation of Optical Channel Signal Loss Following a Near-Surface Nuclear Detonation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We estimate the loss penalty for a free-space, ground to low earth orbit optical communications channel due to lofted atmospheric debris following a nuclear weapon explosion. These losses were estimated over time and compared to other loss sources like clouds and wildfire haze.

articleTitle: Chip-Scale and Tunable Flat-Top Surface Plasmon Polaritons Band-pass Filter at Optical Channels
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present the design and simulation results of a highly-miniaturized and efficient flat-top plasmonic band-pass filter based on a MIM waveguide. In addition to that, it is revealed that by adjusting the length of stub segment, the desired spectral response can be easily realized.

articleTitle: Ultrafast and Nonlinear Semiconductor Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Resonant dielectric metasurfaces offer unparalleled degrees of freedom to design flat-optics and study fundamental aspects of light mater interaction due to the freedom to use optical resonances of electrical and magnetic character and different symmetries, extremely low loss when operating below the semiconductor band gap, and controlled coupling and interactions between the meta-atoms. Additionally, transient sub-picosecond behavior can be imparted to the metasurface using pulsed pumping and controlling of carrier dynamics and decay. In this talk I will overview some of our work based on such metasurfaces made from III-V semiconductors. [1] In particular, I will focus on harmonic generation, [2– 5] ultrafast switching and diffraction, [6– 8] transient frequency conversion [9] and perfect absorbing metasurfaces for THz emission and detection. [10– 15]

articleTitle: Programmable Metastructures for Directional Light Emission
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The ultra-thin optical structures of high-refractive-index materials can be used to control light at the subwavelength scale. In this work, we examine the scattering properties as well as reflection, transmission, and change of light phase in various high-index nanopillars supporting Mie resonances.

articleTitle: Status of the IEEE P4001 Working Group for Standardization in Hyperspectral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The IEEE P4001 working group is developing a standard for hyperspectral imaging. The standard will define camera characteristics, test methods, data flows, and terminology. An important aim is to define characteristics that fully specify the performance of a hyperspectral camera.

articleTitle: Bioinspired Photonics: Camouflage Strategies from Marine Hatchetfish for Optical RF Steganography
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Marine Hatchetfish camouflage strategies - silvering and counterillumination are imitated using photonics for enabling dynamic stealth transmission. 200MBaud/s 16-QAMOFDM signal has successfully hidden in all domains during radioover-fiber transmission and retrieved at the designated stealth receiver.

articleTitle: Excitonic emission dynamics at cryogenic- and above room temperature in high brightness sub-micron fin LED and Lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A n-ZnO fin - p-GaN UV light-emitting diode (LED) with sub-μm m2 lateral size is presented that exceeds the output power of previous nanoscale light sources by a factor of 1000, generating 1 $\mu m$ Watt to 20 $\mu m$ Watt power. To better understand the origin of the improved efficiency in these nanostructures relative to other nanostructures, we will investigate the collection of electrons and holes by fins at cryogenic- and room temperatures. At low temperatures of about 6 K, electron-hole recombination dominantly occurs in the GaN side. As the temperature increases to RT, the fin LED radiative recombination migrates to the ZnO fin and becomes dominantly excitonic. At higher temperatures, results show ZnO performs better than GaN as the oscillator strength of the excitonic emission in ZnO stays independent of the heterojunction temperature. We will also discuss the structural advantage of fins in heat dissipation and their droop-free behavior at high temperatures indicating their importance in realization of high temperature UV LEDs and lasers.

articleTitle: Dynamic Photonics with Unconventional Materials
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Reconfigurable photonic devices that can change in functionality can transform the design of next-generation optical devices such as modulators, sensors, and signal processors. We present the notion of transient photonic devices based on Mg, where we demonstrate color pixels formed by Mg/MgO/Mg thin films. Vivid colors ranging from blue to burgundy are obtained by varying the thickness of the dielectric spacer. The pixels vanish in hue in less than 10 minutes due to the dissolution of both Mg and MgO in water, at room temperature and neutral pH. A detailed discussion of the etching mechanism and its dependence on temperature and thin film deposition method will be presented. We will also present dynamic devices that change in color. Our paradigm is relevant for applications ranging from encryption to biodegradable displays. Concerning sensors, we demonstrate how the optical response of Au-Pd alloys can be modified on demand, as a function of both chemical composition and amount of hydrogen.

articleTitle: Built-In-Test for Fiber Optic Links
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: this work covers the historical development of Built-In-Test (BIT) for Fiber Optic Links for military applications and Optical Time Domain Reflectometry (OTDR). The original issue was that installed fiber optic links must be broken before diagnosis could begin, often resulting in “no fault found” (NFF).

articleTitle: Dielectric Fiber-assisted Terahertz Communication Links: Perspectives and Challenges for Onboard and Secure Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In this paper, we present various types of dielectric terahertz (THz) fibers and their key parameters that must be considered for efficient designs. We show that the THz fibers can be a promising solution for providing secure and high-speed onboard connectivity.

articleTitle: Ultra-narrow linewidth lasers and microcombs based on self-injection locking in integrated photonics (Invited)
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recent developments of self-injection locking of a DFB laser with an ultra-high Q resonator have enabled unprecedented low-noise performance of coherent light sources. We review the demonstration of ultra-narrow linewidth laser and microcombs in integrated photonics based on this approach.

articleTitle: Design of Solar Blind Photodetectors for Communication with Red Signal (λ=650nm) in Space. Part I
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Made of, Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>As, the device realizes window discrimination of input wavelengths enabled by a double barrier tunneling photodetector determining the upper limit of acceptable band. A solar cell grown on top determines lower limit of the band and provides required voltage supply to the photodetector.

articleTitle: Monolithic Multi-QCL For Temperature Measurements In Detonations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A novel laser device is fabricated which combines multiple lasers into compact package and is demonstrated for practical laser absorption spectroscopy applications. The device was designed to target NO spectrum at multiple wavelengths to resolve temperature and was demonstrated in a shock tube.

articleTitle: MBE Growth and Characterization of InAlGaAs/GaAs Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: InAlGaAs/GaAs quantum dots (QDs) are grown by molecular beam epitaxy and subsequently characterized to achieve emission $\lt 1\ \mu$m. Growth parameters are optimized to grow a new generation of homogeneous quaternary QDs with a PL FWHM of $\sim 60\ \mathrm{meV}$ and a surface density of $\gt10^{10} \mathrm{~cm}^{-2}$.

articleTitle: Effect of temperature on a widely range GHz Passive Mode Locked Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We demonstrated a widely temperature range PMLFL cavity with a frequency repetition higher than one gigahertz. Moreover, the influence of temperature on the PMLFL cavity key parameters for the pulse formation were analyzed and studied.

articleTitle: Excited-State Properties of (Alkynyl)Gold(I) Fluorenyls
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Static and ultrafast optical characterization of gold(I) alkynyls having 2,7-disubstituted fluorenyl moieties are described herein. Capping phosphine or N-heterocyclic carbene ligands on Au control rates of radiative and nonradiative decay, and of intersystem crossing. Density-functional theory calculations indicate that luminescence originates from the alkynyl ligands.

articleTitle: Wired Channel Modeling for Frequency Hopping System in Secure Terahertz Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present the design of a wired terahertz communication link in a short range (1.5 m) frequency hopping system for secure communication applications. The performance of the system is analyzed based on the frequency dependent terahertz power, responsivity of the detector, dispersion and propagation loss.

articleTitle: Development of a Single, Scalable Testing Platform for Read-In Integrated Circuit LED Wafers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Infrared Scene Projectors contain a RIIC Wafer that must undergo significant testing, as it is used to drive LED arrays and is a key component of the system. This paper highlights the development of a scalable test procedure to ensure proper fabrication of the RIIC.

articleTitle: Chemical and Mechanical Dissymmetries in Chiral Plasmonic Interactions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We discuss here chemical and mechanical properties arising from chiro-optical characteristics of plasmons. We report chiro-optical microscopic imaging of chiral plasmons, highly circularly polarized luminescence, creation of chiral structures from achiral material with circularly polarized light, and optical trapping of chiral nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Architectural Design of Close Support Electronics to Expand Functionality of Superlattice LED Infrared Scene Projectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The close support electronics driving the SLEDs IRSP systems must evolve to match increased resolution and frame-rate demands. This paper describes the design and implementation of the next generation NESSIE2 CSE. Design considerations for a more robust third generation NESSIE3 distributed FPGA CSE are discussed.

Author Keywords: Infrared light emitting diodes scene projectors

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared Photodetection Enhanced by Localized Surface Plasmon Resonance Assisted NiSi/Si Schottky Photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Here, inverted-pyramid array structures (IPAS) are applied on NiSi/n-Si Schottky photodetectors to generate surface plasmon resonance and improve the photoresponse in mid-infrared region. Consequently, compared with the planar devices, the current response of 8-$\mu$m-period IPAS devices increases 4.08 times in 3.2-$\mu$m light illumination.

articleTitle: Higher time-resolution LASEM with upgraded diagnostics for lab-scale characterization of energy release rates
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A newly upgraded laser-induced air shock from energetic materials (LASEM) system with improved time-resolution and diagnostic capabilities has been used to investigate the influence of aluminum morphology on the energy release rates (microsecond and millisecond timescales) and high-temperature chemistry of military explosives.

articleTitle: Characteristic Mode Analysis for Analyzing and Optimizing Plasmonic Nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recently, Characteristic Mode Analysis (CMA) has received rising interest in many applications. In this paper, we review the CMA for the analysis and optimization of 1D, 2D, and 3D nanostructures for the applications of sensor design and the nondestructive evaluation of nanostructure composites.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of Confinement Losses in Semiconductor-core Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The sources of the confinement losses in semiconductor-core optical fibers are numerically investigated by introducing fabrication-inspired imperfections such as micro-cracks and core ellipticity. The imperfections increase the losses up to 200 dB/m at the targeted spectrum that is comparable to experimental findings.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator metasurface aberration corrector inverse design for mid-infrared imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Inverse design of silicon-on-insulator metasurfaces for aberration correction purpose is demonstrated numerically. Here, image quality of a bulk midwave infrared lens is improved by combining it with two metasurfaces designed by the adjoint gradient method to form a hybrid imaging system.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetically Transparent and Microbial Corrosion Resistant Nanoscale Protective Coating
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Numerous applications nowadays require radiofrequency devices to be directly positioned in adverse environments, leading to microbial corrosion and failures. This research presents a new type of electromagnetically transparent and microbial corrosion resistant nanoscale protective coating using a two-dimensional layer of hexagonal Boron Nitride on copper for radiofrequency applications between 1 to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Integrated Magnetic-free Nitride Optical Isolator
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We demonstrated an integrated magnetic-free optical isolator for Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonics using AlN piezoelectric actuators via spatio-temporal modulation. By entering into the strong mode coupling regime, maximum of 9dB isolation and <1 dB insertion loss is achieved under 100mW RF power applied at each actuator.

articleTitle: On the Rotation of the Field from a Dipole using Transformation Electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Using a coordinate transformation approach a new material is designed such that a horizontal dipole embedded in this material has a field external to the material with the behavior of a vertical dipole in free space. The material is a square rotator medium designed using appropriate coordinate transformations. Numerical simulations are performed in the COMSOL Multiphysics tool to validate the theory used to define the material parameters and to demonstrate the success of the proposed material-embedded horizontal dipole at microwave frequencies. It is believed that the proposed coordinate transformations-based material embedded antenna could have tremendous potential in phased array scanning.

articleTitle: Antimonide-Based Avalanche Photodiodes on InP Substrates
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We have investigated the multiplication characteristics of two multipliers on InP substrates: AlGaAsSb and AlInAsSb. We have demonstrated decrease in the excess noise factors using ternary superlattices and extremely low excess noise factors $(\mathrm{k}\sim 0.01)$ and low dark current density $(\sim10 \mu \mathrm{A/cm}^{\mathbf{2}}$) at 300K.

articleTitle: Space test of photonic integrated materials and devices
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: As a lightweight and low power alternative to the fiber-based RF-photonic components, photonic integrated circuits (PICs) are well suited for aerospace applications and, in particular, for free-space communications and remote sensing/imaging. In this work we present the design, fabrication, and space radiation testing of high-speed PICs as a means to elevate their technology readiness level (TRL) for avionics. Our efforts focus on improving the efficiency and bandwidth of thin-film lithium niobate and silicon-based devices as well as studying their envrionmental stability for aerospace applications. These devices will be compared between pre- and post-radiation silicon photonic devices for a space environment of near earth orbit.

articleTitle: Future Applications of Photonics and Emerging Technologies for Security and Defense Using Drones in Africa
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Africa has imported most of its security and defense drones. This paper explores the opportunities and challenges in advancing drones using photonics and emerging technologies and proposes a military-standard drone solution with essential technologies, affordable and manufacturable in Africa.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonic Multiband Band Pass Filters For THz Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This article reports the numerical analysis of nanoplasmonic multiband bandpass filter using metal-insulator-metal step impedance resonator (MIMSIR) with a dual-band impedance inverter by applying full-wave analysis, approximately at 1300 nm and 1600 nm wavelengths.

articleTitle: Testing and Evaluation of an Improved Infrared Scene Projector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The latest Infrared Scene Projector (IRSP) system called Improved SLEDS (ISLEDS) was developed with the aim of iterating on the current generation of IRSP technology. This paper will detail the testing and evaluation of the ISLEDS projector system.

articleTitle: High Temperature DBR Laser Diodes for Quantum Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Next-generation portable PNT systems using Alkali-atom and cold-atom physics require robust low SWaP+C laser diode sources that operate under a wide range of environmental conditions. Photodigm has developed high operating temperature (HOT) Distributed Bragg Reflector (DBR) lasers at key Alkali-atom wavelengths for quantum sensing applications.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Integrated Sparse Optical Phased Array for Free-Space Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a new design for high-power, large-scale optical phased arrays (OPA) based on heterogeneous integration of SOI and SiN photonics. The OPA consists of sparsely spaced subarrays on SOI chiplets 3-D integrated on a SiN interposer. Simulation results demonstrate the performance.

articleTitle: Characterization of the Binding Affinity of a Cancer Biomarker and Its Antibody Using Dielectrophoresis
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We demonstrate a label-free method to characterize the antibody and antigen binding affinity using the prostate-specific antigen (PSA) and its antibody in a phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) solution using dielectrophoresis and image processing.

articleTitle: Scalable Quantum Networks with Artificial Atoms
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The central challenge in building quantum computers and long-range quantum networks is distributing entanglement across multiple individually-controllable quantum memories. While proof-of-concept experiments are possible with today’s optical components, scaling these systems to tens, hundreds, or thousands of individually controllable quantum memories requires very-large-scale integration of electronic and photonic circuits.

articleTitle: Assembling a Diamond MASER
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The development of a continuous wave MASER operating at room temperature can have as significant an impact on technology as lasers. Various scientific and engineering challenges have hindered the development. We report on our progress towards building a MASER based on defect spins in diamond.

articleTitle: IR Scene Projection by Optical Down-Conversion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recent work is presented on the development of multiband infrared scene projection technology using a combination of down-converters and conventional display systems. Phosphor materials and quantum dots were prepared using solid-state and colloidal techniques and applied as films or printed pixels to various imaging devices.

articleTitle: Stimulated Rotational Raman Scattering in Hydrogen-Filled Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a multispectral laser for LIDAR applications based on stimulated Raman scattering in a hydrogen-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber. Six rotational Stokes orders with unique temporal profiles are produced in 1.5-2 bar H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with 7 ns pulses from a 1.064 μm pump laser.

articleTitle: Random Laser Dynamics in Disordered and Semi-ordered Cavities
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Random lasers are unique systems where lasing occurs via repetitive scattering in a disordered nanostructure with gain. Stability conditions and equations of motion describing multimodal stability will be presented. These results apply to semi-ordered and totally random semiconducting lasers and can be generalized to other materials.

articleTitle: Controlled Chemistry Through Merging of Two Droplets in an Acoustic Levitator Via Low-Frequency Modulation of the Carrier Wave
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: While chemical reactions studied under single-collision conditions and laser manipulation of reactants have transformed our understanding of elementary gas-phase reactions, the versatile control of reactions in the liquid phase by merging two chemically distinct droplets has not been accomplished to date. We report on a unique, material-independent approach to merge two chemically distinct droplets suspended in an acoustic levitator by low-frequency modulation of the ultrasonic carrier wave (Figure 1). The performance of this approach is demonstrated by first studying the oxidation of a hypergolic ionic liquid [BMIM][DCA] with nitric acid, while tracing the physical and chemical changes via Raman, Fourier-transform infrared, and ultraviolet-visible spectroscopies. Our versatile approach is extended to merging of a solid particle of anhydrous copper sulfate (CuSO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4)</inf> and a water-liquid droplet. These results may fundamentally change how scientists explore and control chemical reactions in liquids relevant to combustion systems, material sciences, medicinal chemistry, planetary sciences, and biochemistry.

articleTitle: High-Performance GaN-Based Ultraviolet Photon Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report the development of high-performance GaN ultraviolet avalanche photodiode technology with uniform dark current characteristics. These devices exhibited high-avalanche-gain (>10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) in linear-mode operation in 6x6 array form with pixel sizes up to 70x70 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: optimizing sensor design using a time-limited search model for moving sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Military-developed time-limited search modeling is applied to results from a human perception test using static imagery to evaluate and optimize a moving sensor system for human detection performance.

articleTitle: Anti-Resonant Hollow Core Fiber for High Power Laser Delivery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Anti-resonant hollow core fiber (ARHCF) has the potential to guide high power laser light in a single mode without fiber damage or unwanted nonlinearities. Here, fabricated ARHCF is explored for the delivery of hundred-Watt level 1064 nm light for directed energy applications.
